globalPrompt.contextTemplate.desc: Controls the Story String used by Text Completion APIs. Chat Completion uses structured role messages instead.
globalPrompt.placeholder.clickHint: Click a placeholder to insert its recommended snippet at the current cursor position.
globalPrompt.placeholder.char: Character name. Inserted directly because a character always has a name.
globalPrompt.placeholder.description: Character description. The recommended conditional block only emits it when the field is not empty.
globalPrompt.placeholder.personality: Character personality. The conditional block omits it when no personality is defined.
globalPrompt.placeholder.scenario: Current scenario or situation defined on the character card.
globalPrompt.placeholder.system: Effective System Prompt: the character override when provided, otherwise the global System Prompt.
globalPrompt.placeholder.persona: Active user Persona text. It stays empty until Persona support is connected.
globalPrompt.placeholder.loreBefore: Lorebook/world information intended to appear before the character context.
globalPrompt.placeholder.loreAfter: Lorebook/world information intended to appear after the main character context.
globalPrompt.placeholder.anchorBefore: Reserved anchor inserted before context when a prompt preset or extension provides one.
globalPrompt.placeholder.anchorAfter: Reserved anchor inserted after context when a prompt preset or extension provides one.
globalPrompt.placeholder.mesExamples: Character example messages, when present in an imported card.
globalPrompt.placeholder.mesExamplesRaw: Raw character example messages before Context preset separators are applied.
globalPrompt.placeholder.trim: Removes the newline immediately around this marker without trimming spaces. Usually placed at the end of a Story String to avoid a trailing blank line.
globalPrompt.instructionTemplate.desc: Formatting sequences for text-completion / instruct models. Choose values that match the chat template expected by the model.
globalPrompt.instruction.chatCompletionN: Instruction Mode is applied only to Text Completion. It wraps the rendered Story String, examples, history and final generation prefix exactly in the selected instruct format; structured Chat Completion keeps native roles.
globalPrompt.systemPrompt.desc: Default system instruction injected into the Context Template through {{system}}. Character cards can override it.
globalPrompt.postHistory.desc: Global instructions appended after the rendered context. A character-specific value replaces this global value.
globalPrompt.overrideRule: Override rule: if the character card defines its own System Prompt and/or Post-History Instructions, that card value replaces the corresponding global value. Leaving the card field empty uses the global default.
character.systemPrompt.overrideHelp: Optional override. Leave empty to use Global Prompt → System Prompt.
character.postHistory.overrideHelp: Optional override. Leave empty to use the global Post-History Instructions.
character.contextTemplate.overrideHelp: Optional override. Leave empty to use Configuration → Global Prompt → Context Template.
globalPrompt.presets.label: Context preset
globalPrompt.presets.restored: Factory version of the preset restored.
globalPrompt.presets.nameExists: A context preset with this name already exists.
globalPrompt.preview.title: Prompt Preview
globalPrompt.preview.desc: Preview one effective backend prompt path at a time. Chat Completion uses structured messages; Text Completion uses Context + examples + history + Instruction Template.
globalPrompt.preview.emptyBody: Create or import a character in Library to preview its prompt.
globalPrompt.preview.sampleUser: This is an example user message used only for prompt preview.
globalPrompt.context.alwaysForceName: Always add the character's name to the prompt
globalPrompt.context.singleLine: Generate only one line per request
globalPrompt.context.formattingHint: These options follow SillyTavern Text Completion formatting. Example behavior controls how example dialogues compete for the context budget; collapse newlines and trim spaces are global formatting preferences.
globalPrompt.preview.chatNote: Chat Completion does not use the Context Template or Instruction Template. The preview shows structured role messages in prompt-manager order.
globalPrompt.preview.textNote: Text Completion renders the active Context preset, example separator, chat start, history and Instruction Template into one final prompt.
models.apiMode.desc: Choose how NastyVerse talks to this backend. Auto uses Text Completion for KoboldCpp, llama.cpp server and text-generation-webui, and Chat Completion for Ollama and Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
params.contextTokens.desc: Approximate total context budget used when assembling Text Completion prompts. Examples are removed first, then the oldest chat messages, while reserving room for the response.
globalPrompt.preview.contextTrimmed: Context fitting removed {examples} example block(s) and {messages} old message(s).
globalPrompt.preview.overBudget: The permanent context still exceeds the configured prompt budget.
models.connectedNoModels: Connected successfully. The backend did not report a model list.
globalPrompt.instruction.activationRegex: When a connected model name matches this regular expression, NastyVerse can auto-select this preset. Invalid expressions are ignored.
globalPrompt.instruction.skipExamples: Ignore instruction formatting for example messages
globalPrompt.instruction.systemSameUser: Format system messages as user messages
globalPrompt.instruction.userAlignment.h: Optional user message inserted at the start of chat history when it does not begin with a User turn. This keeps alternating instruction formats aligned.
globalPrompt.instruction.deriveModel.hin: If no activation regex matched, try to select a known instruction family from the connected model identifier. Context binding still follows the selected preset name.
globalPrompt.instruction.importInvalid: This file is not a valid instruction preset.
globalPrompt.context.compactSyntaxHint: Conditional blocks are shown one per line. \n means “emit a line break inside this condition”; NastyVerse restores the original SillyTavern-compatible Story String when saving.
globalPrompt.preview.chatBlock: Chat block (Chat Start + retained history + generation line)
models.model.currentOnly: This backend reports the model already loaded by the server.
models.model.connectFirst: Connect to the API to read the model state.
models.connection.desc: Choose a local backend or an API provider, then connect. Provider-specific model details stay in this single view.
models.apiKey.missing: Enter an API key for this provider.
models.launcherUpdateRequired: This feature requires NastyVerse Launcher 0.1.10 or newer. Update the native launcher, then restart NastyVerse.
models.analysis.title: Model analysis
models.analysis.desc: Inspect the connected model and derive the most appropriate Context and Instruct presets from backend metadata and its chat template. If those are inconclusive in Text Completion mode, NastyVerse runs short behavioral calibration prompts on the loaded model.
models.analysis.empty: Connect to a backend and select or load a model, then run the analysis.
models.analysis.recommendationHint: Recommendations prefer the model chat template when the backend exposes it, then fall back to recognizable model metadata.
models.analysis.noRecommendationHint: The backend did not expose enough reliable information to select a preset automatically.
models.analysis.deepProbeHint: When metadata is inconclusive, NastyVerse sends short calibration prompts through the loaded model and compares instruction following, role separation and template-marker leakage.
models.analysis.runtimeRecommendationHin: Metadata was inconclusive, so NastyVerse tested several compatible Context/Instruct pairs against the loaded model. The recommendation below is the best clear result from that calibration.
models.analysis.runtimeNoRecommendationH: Metadata was inconclusive and the behavioral test did not produce a clear winner. No preset is applied automatically.
models.analysis.source.runtime-behaviora: Behavioral calibration on the loaded model
general.chatTranslation.desc: Keep English as the prompt source while displaying chat messages in your chosen language.
general.chatTranslation.launcherUpdateRe: Chat translation requires NastyVerse Launcher 0.1.12 or newer.
personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.desc: Customize how Markdown is rendered inside chat messages. These settings only change presentation; the stored message and prompt context stay untouched.
personalization.preview.quote: A quote gets its own visual treatment.
personalization.dialogueQuotes.help: Dialogue detected with "...", “...” or «...» is automatically displayed with this style. Nested quotations automatically use the opposite style so they remain unambiguous. The source text stays unchanged.
personalization.messages.desc: Control the global message layout, maximum width, spacing, and Persona/Character avatar presentation.
personalization.messages.avatarHelp: Replies use the avatar of the Character Card that spoke. Your messages use the active Persona avatar. If no image exists, NastyVerse shows the name initial.
personalization.messages.preview.assista: “This is what a character reply looks like with the current settings.”
personalization.messages.preview.userMes: An example message sent with your Persona.
